summary: Acceptance is blocked. Runtime validation explicitly permits cached U-Net probabilities to bypass checkpoint presence and SHA-256 enforcement, while cache files themselves are not content-hashed. Deterministic inference is requested only with warn_only=True, so provenance can label execution deterministic even when PyTorch permits a nondeterministic operation. The validation report's principal full-specimen replay and reports are absent from the acceptance candidate, and the automated suite could not be independently reproduced in the supplied environment.

findings.title: Probability caches bypass mandatory checkpoint identity enforcement
findings.impact: A U-Net-primary run can be accepted with no checkpoint and no verified relationship between cached probabilities and the production checkpoint. This directly defeats a stated high-risk acceptance criterion and permits behavior to change without the selected model identity being enforceable.
evidence: sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:793-810 gates checkpoint existence and SHA-256 validation on the cache being absent.
tests/test_saturn_v57_unet_primary.py:127-139 explicitly expects validation to succeed with an arbitrary cache and an empty checkpoint path.
utils/tune_parameters_Saturnv5_7_1.py:335-348 creates a tuner cache manifest, but the general runtime validator does not require, authenticate, or inspect that manifest.
findings.recommendation: Require every cached inference path to carry a validated manifest containing the production checkpoint SHA-256, output-head mode, all inference parameters, ordered source-image content hashes, ROI/exclusion hashes, and per-cache-file hashes. Reject caches without this provenance and add adversarial tests for arbitrary, altered, missing-core, and stale caches.

findings.title: Cache validity depends on mutable filesystem metadata and unauthenticated TIFFs
findings.impact: Changing an input while preserving size and mtime, or modifying a cached probability TIFF without changing its shape, can silently reuse stale or corrupted inference results.
evidence: utils/tune_parameters_Saturnv5_7_1.py:325-332 omits source-image content hashes.
utils/tune_parameters_Saturnv5_7_1.py:383-400 accepts cached maps based on manifest equality, file existence, and shape.
utils/tune_parameters_Saturnv5_7_1.py:432-435 stores no digest for generated foreground or core cache files.
findings.recommendation: Hash source pixels/files and every generated cache map, store those hashes in an atomically written manifest, and verify them before reuse. Add same-size/same-mtime source replacement and cache-tampering tests.

findings.title: Deterministic provenance overstates enforcement
findings.impact: On CUDA or MPS, a nondeterministic operation may emit only a warning and continue while the archived runtime provenance still states deterministic inference was enabled, undermining cross-device reproducibility.
evidence: utils/saturn_unet25d_bridge.py:63-69 invokes deterministic algorithms with `warn_only=True`.
utils/saturn_unet25d_bridge.py:70-83 records the requested boolean rather than successful deterministic enforcement.
tests/test_saturn_v571_audit_blockers.py:337-364 tests repeatability only on CPU.
findings.recommendation: For production, use fail-closed deterministic enforcement or explicitly mark results as nondeterministic when an unsupported operation occurs. Retain CPU/CUDA/MPS reproducibility results, tolerances, software versions, and device identifiers.

findings.title: Principal full-specimen validation evidence is absent
findings.impact: The reported production replay, source-table/report agreement, and report paths cannot be independently inspected or regenerated from the acceptance candidate, leaving major report and integration claims unsupported.
evidence: V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:59-95 cites final replay outputs and PDFs under `scratch/v571_post_audit_remediation_pilot_run3`.
Read-only command `Test-Path scratch/v571_post_audit_remediation_pilot_run3` returned `False`.
`git ls-files scratch/v571_post_audit_remediation_pilot_run3` returned no retained artifacts.
findings.recommendation: Retain a compact immutable replay package containing manifests, source-table checksums, report inputs, generated reports, command line, environment lock, and machine-readable validation results, or revise the claim to exclude evidence that is not shipped.

findings.title: Entry-point test uses self-fulfilling source-string assertions
findings.impact: The test can pass even if imports, argument propagation, profile loading, subprocess invocation, or runtime dispatch fail.
evidence: tests/test_saturn_v571_audit_blockers.py:396-405 merely searches source text for three filenames.
The actual dispatch logic spans scripts/run_v571_study.py:15-42 and utils/tuner_gui_Saturnv5_7_1.py:31-139, none of which is executed by that test.
findings.recommendation: Add integration tests that import each wrapper, build/parse representative arguments, load the real production profile, validate the real checkpoint, and execute mocked terminal processing boundaries while asserting the effective runtime configuration and serialized settings.

findings.title: Production profile contains a user-specific absolute preview path
findings.impact: Although dialog selection is the current default, switching the saved selection mode to path can expose a nonportable local path and confuse reproducibility records.
evidence: production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json:4 selects dialog mode.
production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json:5 embeds `C:\Users\dmishra\Desktop\sperm images\Project001_Series002_z15_ch00.tif`.
findings.recommendation: Remove user-specific data paths from the production profile or replace them with an empty value that fails with a clear selection prompt.

limitations: No full image stack was run, as instructed.
Other reviewers' outputs were not read.
The managed filesystem was read-only, preventing pytest installation, temporary-directory creation by the tuner self-check, and bytecode-cache creation by compileall.
CUDA and Apple MPS hardware were not available for device-specific inference validation.
recommended_follow_up: Block acceptance until cache provenance is fail-closed and checkpoint SHA-256 enforcement applies equally to cached and live inference.
Add executable integration tests for GUI preflight, GUI single-slice, GUI batch, tuner GUI subprocess construction, tuner CLI, Study Manager, study CLI, and direct CLI dispatch.
Retain the final replay evidence and machine-readable test report in an immutable audit artifact tied to commit 5bb5a836e30ed0a8b4f6644e3e5f30d680f6ad4e.
Rerun the complete suite in the declared supported Python/Torch environment on CPU and at least one production accelerator, then conduct a superseding independent audit run from a clean tree.
